nodes.title: Customer page
nodes.does: Shows the chat and the list of charges. It calls POST /api/v1/chat. The bank sets the name and the accent color.
nodes.runs: A static page that the FastAPI process serves. It takes the brand from configuration.
nodes.prod: The same page, with the brand of the bank.

nodes.title: Login and session
nodes.does: Proves who the customer is. Each tool call is bound to this session. The model never sees the customer id.
nodes.runs: Test users with a fixed test login. They prove the session design, not a real identity check.
nodes.prod: The identity provider of the bank.

nodes.title: Data masking
nodes.does: Masks personal identifiers in the customer text before any model call.

nodes.title: Orchestrator + router
nodes.does: A prompted LLM labels the intent. It decides nothing else. A keyword baseline answers a turn when the model fails.
nodes.runs: GLM 5.3 Flash on Fireworks AI with live calls. The keyword baseline is the per-turn fallback.
nodes.prod: The same weights on Azure AI Foundry or Databricks.

nodes.title: Turn records and logs
nodes.does: Writes one record for each turn, chained so that a change shows.
nodes.runs: JSON lines to Log Analytics on the public link.

nodes.title: Policy engine
nodes.does: Allows, refuses or hands off. It returns a rule id for each decision. A request to explain gets the stored decision.
nodes.runs: The production code. The rule values (window, fraud and amount thresholds) are team-written and labelled synthetic.
nodes.prod: The same code with the policy that the bank approves.

nodes.title: Confirm + read-back
nodes.does: Asks the customer to confirm the charge. After the action, it reads the case back from the store and says so only when the case exists.

nodes.title: Session-bound tools
nodes.does: Reads charges and opens a dispute for the session account only. No tool takes a customer id from the model.
nodes.runs: The production code. It reads the Gold mock on the public link.
nodes.prod: The same code, on the real Gold.

nodes.title: Advisor view
nodes.does: Shows the handoff package: the request, the verified facts, the actions that the system tried and the trace of each step.
nodes.runs: A demo advisor user with a read-only ticket view.
nodes.prod: A human advisor. Tickets go to the bank CRM through a queue.

nodes.title: Case store
nodes.does: Keeps sessions, conversation state, dispute cases and handoff tickets. A restart keeps them.
nodes.runs: SQLite, with the same models. It records the case. No bank system receives it.
nodes.prod: PostgreSQL, and the dispute system of the bank.

nodes.title: Gold store
nodes.does: Holds the charges of each customer, without personal identifiers.
nodes.runs: On the public link, a labelled in-memory store. On a local run, the PII-free DuckDB view of synthetic data.

nodes.title: Bronze, Silver, Gold
nodes.does: Turns the raw tables into the PII-free Gold view.
nodes.runs: Real code run locally on DuckDB. The data is the synthetic dataset.
nodes.prod: The same package on Azure Databricks.
